runtime.attribution_caveat.name: runtime.attribution_caveat
runtime.attribution_caveat.note: KAPSO files the harness's number under the registered evaluator's id; A1 must not read its ledger as evidence

runtime.grant_triple.name: runtime.grant_triple
runtime.grant_triple.note: derived from the runtime; a hardcoded triple is silently discarded when the grant differs (HARNESS-OWNED-EVAL.md §7.2)

runtime.outcome_lane.name: runtime.outcome_lane
runtime.outcome_lane.note: the post-session manifest write; the ordering IS the attribution

runtime.registered_evaluation_tree.name: runtime.registered_evaluation_tree
runtime.registered_evaluation_tree.note: KAPSO's registered evaluator for T1; EID_r = manifest_fingerprint(tree). Recomputed from a0/a1/kapso_t1/tree/ by declaration.py, and cross-checked against a0/a1/kapso_t1/binding.json.

runtime.registered_evaluation_tree_files.name: runtime.registered_evaluation_tree_files
runtime.registered_evaluation_tree_files.note: the fingerprint's inputs (KAPSO's own rule: sha256 over json.dumps(manifest, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))). One byte in either file changes this factor.

runtime.substrate.name: runtime.substrate
runtime.substrate.note: KAPSO's score-of-record path is a *different mechanism* (the manifest line), which is why it is an arm
